request.description: A single horizontal WAVE COUNTER plaque for Dungeon Matcher, isolated transparent pixel-art UI asset. Match the supplied native SharedGuide button's silver-gray stone frame, dark muted plum bevel shadows, rounded bolt sockets in all four corners, straight clean stone rails and near-black inset. Same chunky crisp native pixel clusters and simple top-left lighting as that button. Canvas 144x48 pixels; main rectangular plaque occupies x2..141, y3..37 with a small attached bone skull pendant centered directly underneath at y38..45, attached structurally by a short stone tab, no floating parts. Frame balanced and symmetric, ample flat near-black center to receive live game text. No text, letters, numbers, symbols inside the panel, background scene, teal water, seaweed, gems, chains, extra ornaments, blue glow or painterly anti-aliasing. Keep ornament modest; most of the shape is a sturdy rectangular stone UI plate. The underwater wave screenshot is only proportion/role inspiration; remove its irregular teal bars and glitchy ends. The exact native guide sprite is the rendering and material authority.

reference_images.usage: User-selected button family and restrained silver stone material.
Wave counter role with a small attached skull below; replace the irregular teal frame with matching stone.
